This plot is very small, so I will not buy chemical fertilizer for it this season because one bag is too costly for me and I cannot easily split it well on 0.05 hectare. I will use the cassava stems I can get around me, and I will put small compost and household manure on the ridges because the land is my own and I can keep building it slowly. I will depend on the rains, and I will clear and weed mostly with family hands. I will not pay for outside labor unless there is a serious delay, and for now I will plan without it.
